subject: general
question: Pt Bhimsen Joshi is associated with which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustani music vocalist.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Pt Bhimsen Joshi is known for the **khayal form of singing, as well as for his popular renditions of devotional music (bhajans and abhangs)**.
 
• Joshi belongs to the Kirana gharana tradition of **Hindustani Classical Music****.**
 
• He received his training in singing and harmonium from **Shamacharya Joshi.**
 
• Joshi heard **Ustad Abdul Kareem Khan** and decided to sing like him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan **is an **Indian classical sarod player**, best known for his clear and fast ekhara taans. Khan was born into a classical musical family and has performed internationally **since the 1960s.****​ **
 
• **Ravi Shankar KBE** was an Indian** sitarist and composer. **
 
• **Subbaraya Sastri**, born 1803 - rare honour to learn from the Trinity of **Carnatic Music.**
